name: Nova Era:Atom ﻿
description:
About This Game

Explore mysterious galaxies one after another in a high-dimensional universe known as String Realm. Each galaxy harbors unique civilizations and abundant resources. Discover and strive to survive within perilous sectors to establish your strongholds. Mine, transport, manufacture, and advance your talents and technology. Battle hostile factions and alien creatures to secure their data for research and cultivation. Evolve your Flux-Core Vessel into a higher-tier craft, enabling your journey into even more dangerous reaches of space.

Traverse a multitude of mysterious star systems, each teeming with unique resources, the skeletal remains of derelict megastructures, and hidden outposts tucked away within planetary rings. A vast array of breathtaking vistas and deep-space secrets awaits your discovery.

Discover, gather, and bring resources back to the Ark’s Bio-Chamber for processing. Craft and manufacture to unlock talents for various sub-classes, gaining access to advanced technological blueprints and high-tier materials

Every galaxy boasts its own unique cosmic environment. Encounter the starships of diverse factions or come face-to-face with eerie, otherworldly organisms. You can establish a stronghold anywhere that piques your interest—defend your territory against all odds, or utilize it as a navigation beacon for your next warp jump.

Everything you encounter in these unknown sectors will offer richer experiences and deeper choices. Forge your path as a lone wolf of the stars, or team up with others to explore, discover, and conquer the ultimate challenges.
short_desc: Welcome to the first trailer of Nova Era: Atom, Welcome to Nova Era: Atom, a sci-fi MMORPG game blending Chinese mythology. where you can DIY your own custom spaceship and explore the endless mysteries of the cosmos.
